knownGaps: The 4.x/5.x uni-app Vue3 line still declares an exact Vite 5.2.8 peer and has no patched Vite, so remaining on it is no longer possible; apps/mobile is now on the 10.x line.

CORRECTED 2026-09-13: an earlier version of this gap said the vulnerable package had no fixed release upstream. That was wrong on both counts. adm-zip 0.6.0 was merely the affected upper bound and 0.6.1 is published and unaffected, so the override was raised to 0.6.1 and the lockfile now resolves it. @intlify/core-base has a fixed release at 9.14.5 and above, which leads to the risk acceptance below rather than to a claim that nothing exists.
The uni-app plugin pins preserveSymlinks: true, so pnpm's isolated layout needs a narrow publicHoistPattern for pinia's runtime dependencies.

RESOLVED (2026-09-13): the mobile H5 login form could not be submitted. The page used the HTML type=submit attribute on a uni button, but uni resolves submission from the form-type prop, and it was bound with @submit.prevent, while uni emits submit as a component event with no preventDefault, which Vue silently skips for a non-DOM event. Both are fixed in apps/mobile/src/pages/login/login.vue, and a real-browser run now issues POST /api/v1/auth/login and navigates to onboarding with zero page errors. Whether the 10.x move caused it was never established, because the pre-upgrade build was never probed the same way, but the source comparison showed the two uni-h5 versions share the same form-submit logic, so it is not attributable to this task. Fixed ahead of P1R-M4-001, which owns the login page.

RISK ACCEPTANCE 2026-09-13, owner: platform/security (P1R-M0-006). Moderate advisory GHSA on @intlify/core-base, present at the pinned 9.1.11, fixed at 9.14.5 and above. It is accepted as a known risk for Phase 1 rather than fixed, and the reasons are recorded so the acceptance can be revisited:

The dependency overrides are verified by scripts/dev/check-overrides.mjs, which reads pnpm-lock.yaml and asserts both that the lockfile records each override and that the resolved versions match it. The previous verification method, `pnpm config get overrides`, reports only the workspace-file source and returns undefined for overrides declared in package.json even while they are in effect, so it could not have detected a pin that had stopped applying.
nextSteps: Independent review of this submission (implementer submitted to REVIEW; acceptance is the reviewer's decision).
Re-evaluate whether src/compat/vue.ts and the vue-router entry shim are still required once a later uni-app line stops importing the Vue internals they provide.
